record.original_question: Does there exist a subset A of the natural numbers that is simultaneously more-sums-than-differences, meaning |A+A| > |A-A|, and more-products-than-ratios, meaning |A·A| > |A/A|? If such sets exist, can one produce explicit infinite families of them?

evidence.quote: Question: Is there some subset A ⊂ N that is both MSTD and MPTR?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite nonempty set $A$ of positive integers, define the sumset, difference set, product set, and quotient set
$$A+A=\{a+b:a,b\in A\},\quad A-A=\{a-b:a,b\in A\},$$
$$A\cdot A=\{ab:a,b\in A\},\quad A/A=\{a/b:a,b\in A,\ b\neq 0\}\subset\mathbb{Q}.$$
Call $A$ a more-sums-than-differences (MSTD) set if $|A+A|>|A-A|$, and a more-products-than-ratios (MPTR) set if $|A\cdot A|>|A/A|$.

(a) Does there exist a finite subset $A\subset\mathbb{N}$ that is simultaneously MSTD and MPTR, i.e., satisfies both $|A+A|>|A-A|$ and $|A\cdot A|>|A/A|$?

(b) If yes, exhibit an explicit infinite family of such sets.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches turned up substantial literature on MSTD sets and on MPTQ (more products than quotients) sets separately, including minimum-cardinality bounds for MPTQ sets and constructions of infinite families of MSTD sets. The MPTQ literature notes the close link to MSTD via logarithmic/exponential transformation, but no source found explicitly produces a single set that is simultaneously MSTD and MPTR/MPTQ, nor an infinite family. The status of the joint question therefore appears unresolved in publicly available sources.

status_evidence.title: On Sets with More Products than Quotients
status_evidence.snippet: Defines MPTQ sets |A·A|>|A/A|, gives minimum-cardinality results, and links MPTQ to MSTD via log/exp.
status_evidence.claim: MPTQ sets exist and relate to MSTD via logarithm/exponentiation, but joint MSTD+MPTQ existence not established here.

status_evidence.title: On the Minimum Cardinality of MPTQ Sets, INTEGERS 24 (2024) #A96
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper refining minimum sizes of MPTQ sets of reals.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research on MPTQ sets; no joint MSTD+MPTQ construction reported.

status_evidence.title: Finding and Counting MSTD sets
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys constructions and infinite families of MSTD sets.
status_evidence.claim: Infinite families of MSTD sets are known, but the joint MSTD+MPTR question is not addressed.
